exposure: Intra-amniotic inflammation (IAI) status (without IAI, mild IAI, severe IAI)
outcome: Preterm delivery (<34 weeks and <37 weeks of gestation)
Pregnancy duration from amniocentesis to delivery (latency)
cohort: The study included 452 consecutive women presenting with preterm labor and intact membranes.
finding: Higher amniotic fluid IL-6 concentrations, indicating severe intra-amniotic inflammation, are associated with a significantly shorter latency period to delivery and increased risks of preterm delivery and various adverse perinatal outcomes.
gest_age: The study involved women in preterm labor, with outcomes related to delivery at <34 and <37 weeks of gestation.
